taglines: Your college gets you a degree. Clstr gets you a city.
Find your people. Vizag is the campus.

digital_core.tech_stack: React 18.3, Vite (SWC), Tailwind CSS 3.4, TanStack Query v5, Supabase (PostgreSQL RLS), Vercel CDN
digital_core.purpose: Verified social OS for college students. Campus feeds, direct messaging, verified clubs, CollabHub (hackathon/startup teams), mentor slots, and EcoCampus P2P marketplace.

verification_engine.tier_1: Institutional academic email OTP (.ac.in / .edu) with alias resolution (e.g., @au.edu.in = Andhra University).
verification_engine.tier_2: Personal email + mobile OTP against audited no_edu_colleges database (covering 36 Indian states/UTs).
verification_engine.spectator_mode: Allows browsing feeds and RSVPing to events while awaiting email provision; prevents posting, messaging, commenting, or selling via database RLS triggers.

ground_community.tech_stack: TanStack Start (SSR), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4.2, Nitro, Lenis, Framer Motion, Cloudflare Workers
ground_community.purpose: Hyper-local offline student movement across 19 beachhead Visakhapatnam engineering colleges.

logistical_doctrines.curfew_rule: Over 65% of female hostel students in Vizag have 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM curfews. All public events run Sundays 1:30 PM - 5:30 PM; never past 6:00 PM.
logistical_doctrines.neutral_venue_rotation: Events rotate across neutral venues (Dr. L. Bullayya, A-Hub, public beaches) so Clstr is never seen as a single-college initiative.

ticketing_engine.tech_stack: TanStack Start (SSR), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4.2, Web Workers, HTML5 Canvas QR, Vercel / Cloudflare
features: Dynamic 60s rolling HMAC-SHA256 QR code preventing ticket screenshot fraud
Offline-first gate scanner using IndexedDB for zero-latency venue check-ins
Batch Web Worker PDF certificate generation and zip archiving
Automated ticket and certificate dispatch via WhatsApp Business API and Resend
ticketing_engine.club_promise: 100% free for college student clubs and fest committees (the Trojan horse acquisition wedge).

traction_and_metrics_truth.verified_users_total: 575 registered students (495 at Raghu beachhead anchor, 80 across 46 network colleges)
traction_and_metrics_truth.beachhead_anchor: Raghu Engineering College (495 users, 86.1% local density)

flagship_event_proof.venue: Reagan Function Hall, Ram Nagar, Vizag
flagship_event_proof.critical_lesson: Ran on Konfhub instead of Spark. Proved students will pay ₹349 for high-vibe cross-college connection, but future events must run on Spark and secure ₹15k title sponsors to ensure net positive cash flow.

raghu_mou_v5_binding_rules.incorporation: Must incorporate as Pvt Ltd or LLP within 90 days of MOU execution (Section 14.1).
raghu_mou_v5_binding_rules.compliance_deliverables: Deliver ToS, Privacy Policy, sub-processor list (Supabase AWS Mumbai, Vercel, Cloudflare, Resend), and independent security audit summary before mass student onboarding (Section 9.6).
raghu_mou_v5_binding_rules.insurance: Procure cyber and public liability insurance within 6 months of incorporation (Section 14.4).
raghu_mou_v5_binding_rules.privacy_covenant: Strictly no student data selling, no commercial lead brokering to coaching centers.
raghu_mou_v5_binding_rules.ticket_pricing_rule: Zero profit markups on student ticket prices for partner campus events.

revenue_streams.margin: Targeting 25-35% net margin with title sponsors covering fixed venue costs.

revenue_streams.payer: Local cafes, study-abroad consultants, coding academies, lifestyle brands
revenue_streams.deliverable: Physical stage mention, branded sampling stalls, logo on digital tickets. NEVER student phone lists.

revenue_streams.payer: External commercial event organizers (comedy clubs, music fests, box turf leagues)
revenue_streams.deliverable: Rolling QR ticketing, fraud protection, offline gate check-in.
Pre-vetted student candidate submissions with verified GitHub/portfolio.

strictly_banned: Anonymous campus feeds / Campus Lore / confessions (violates institutional trust and Raghu MOU)
Phantom curiosity notifications (invented 'someone viewed you' alerts)
Hostel/dorm location displays on event guest lists (safety hazard for female students with curfews)
approved_mechanisms: Real-inventory countdowns and scarcity meters in Spark checkout
Opt-in, connections-only attendee facepiles ('Who's Pulling Up')
Post-event 'Who You Met' reciprocal connection prompts 2 hours after event check-in
Hackathon team-up countdown alerts when registration deadlines approach

phase_1.gate_condition: 5 of 15 colleges hit 5-Point Activation Floor for 2 consecutive 6-week cycles, ≥30% repeat event attendance, 2 paid sponsors, and company incorporated.

phase_2.territory: AP Coastal Tech Corridor (Vizag ↔ Vijayawada ↔ Guntur)
phase_2.advantage: Shared JNTUK / Acharya Nagarjuna University exam schedules and 4-hour railway transit.

phase_3.territory: Top 5 Engineering States (Hyd Outer Ring, Chennai/Coimbatore, Pune Outer Ring, Bengaluru Suburbs)

phase_4.territory: Pan-India 36 States & UTs (1,200+ Colleges using 367KB no_edu_colleges database)

scollab.vision: AI-powered academic hub with institutional verification, smart textbook PDF retrieval, study rooms, and performance analytics.

buildtrix.vision: AI-powered MVP builder for non-technical startup founders (2-week sprint roadmaps, investor pitch scripts, validation testing).
